titulo: Me taking a breath before I answer the call
caption:
Me taking a breath before I answer the call

Me taking a breath before I answer the call.

One slow breath out before you answer steadies your voice. Three rings is nothing.

Send it to the friend who lets it ring twice just to get ready.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a window. A phone on the right rings and vibrates. A small amber block figure with white eyes on the left looks at it with wide eyes, then slowly fills with a breath and lets it out with its eyes closed. The phone rings again and it does it again. The third time, its eyes turn happy, it walks toward the phone and a speech bubble says hello, then it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me taking a breath before I answer the call.
